about_the_game:
The sign on your door reads “Data Recovery.” The cases are personal.
Clients arrive with drowned cameras and “empty” albums. If anything survived… it matters. You connect the drive and start the scan—shards of life surface on-screen: creased pixels, motion ghosts, risqué hints, and short live-photo loops from moments meant to stay private. Byte by byte, a memory returns.

Forbidden Files is a file-recovery puzzle with an erotic touch. You extract fragments, stitch them into complete images and brief animations, and curate a discreet Gallery for each case. Begin with simple fixes; progress to messy jobs with damaged sectors and stubborn leftovers. No timers. No alarms. Just the quiet satisfaction of bringing a moment back.

Core Features

  • Scan & surface recoverable fragments from damaged media.

  • Rebuild photos and live-scene loops piece by piece.

  • Curate a Gallery: unlock restored moments and client case notes.

  • Play at your pace: scalable difficulty, assists, and replays for perfectionists.

  • Tasteful adult content: intimate reveals earned through puzzle mastery.

Some files don’t disappear—they wait to be handled with care.
Wishlist now to catch the demo and launch discount.
